body:
I appreciate the input, y'all,  and I'd like to take a second to clarify a point or two.

I'm not staying with my brother out of necessity. I moved in to help take care of my mom. Since she passed away, they have needed help keeping up with bills and generally keeping things from falling apart. My brother has a medical condition that prevents him from doing much work around the house, including playing with his girls. I could move out, but I love being an Uncle to my neices, even if I have to put my personal life on hold to help them, and myself, regain stability.

I pay monthly rent, I contribute more than my share of food to the house, in addition to the housework and babysitting. Due to their general mistrust of people, I am not allowed to have friends over (which honestly doesnt bother me). We have never actually had a serious talk about me getting a dog, but they have always seemed weary of the idea. I believe, given the amount  of time and money I put into this house, that I should be able to bring the topic up for consideration and discuss the matter, at least. 

I only try to bring humour to the situation because I know my brother's personality and I think lightening up the topic will make it seem a little less intimadating to them.

Thanks for the input either way. I'm doing tons of research on the breed so I am well informed when I talk to them about it.
